from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's quarterly financial data needed to compute profit margin and asset turnover."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    total_revenues: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues or net sales amount")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets as of period end")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income or earnings; losses are negative")
    revenues_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of revenue figure: dollars, thousands, millions")
    assets_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of asset figure: dollars, thousands, millions")
    net_income_unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of net income figure: dollars, thousands, millions")
    source_quote: str = Field(description="Brief quote or location reference from document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
